description: Deciphered glyph sets in the QCF4 Bismillah/surah-header font (QBSML). The font has no GSUB/ligature table: every PUA code point maps directly to one pre-composed glyph. Two full styles of surah/juz headers exist (a normally-kerned 'Style A' and a tighter-kerned 'Style B', offset by exactly 0xF8 codepoints), plus a block of opening-page liturgical word-parts and decorative ornaments.

sets.name: surah_headers_style_a_merged
sets.label: Surah name headers — Style A, short surahs merged into shared glyphs

sets.name: surah_headers_style_b
sets.label: Surah name headers — Style B (tight/compact kerning)

sets.name: surah_headers_style_b_merged
sets.label: Surah name headers — Style B, short surahs merged into shared glyphs
